title: Measuring and Optimizing Energy Efficiency in ICT: A Multi-vocal Literature Review on Data Centers, Cloud Computing, and LLM-Driven Code Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rapid growth in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) increases electricity use and environmental impact. Addressing this challenge requires a systematic, software-centric view of how energy and related sustainability attributes are measured, reported, and improved. We present a comprehensive Multi-vocal Literature Review (MLR) integrating peer-reviewed and gray literature to map current practice in measuring and optimizing energy use in ICT software, with emphasis on data centers and cloud computing environments (DCCCEs). First, we synthesize how sustainability is measured across ICT by proposing a taxonomy organized along metric domains (power/energy, energy efficiency, environmental impact) and component granularity (from applications, to containers/VMs, and system-of-systems levels). translated_title: 测量与优化ICT能效：关于数据中心、云计算与LLM驱动代码优化的多声部文献综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18576v1 Announce Type: new 摘要：信息与通信技术（ICT）的快速增长带来了电力消耗的增加和环境影响的加剧。应对这一挑战需要以软件为中心的系统化视角，来理解能源及相关可持续性属性是如何被测量、报告和改进的。我们提出了一项综合性的多声部文献综述（MLR），整合了同行评审文献与灰色文献，以梳理ICT软件能耗测量与优化的当前实践，重点关注数据中心和云计算环境（DCCCEs）。首先，我们综合归纳了可持续性在整个ICT领域中的测量方式，提出了一个按度量领域（功率/能耗、能效、环境影响）和组件粒度（从应用程序、容器/虚拟机，到系统之系统层面）组织的分类体系，并总结了测量方法及其对应的工具生态。其次，我们在软件层面综述了优化策略……
tldr: 该论文通过整合学术与灰色文献的多声部综述，提出了ICT（尤其是数据中心与云计算环境）能耗测量与优化的分类体系和实践图谱，并综述了包括LLM驱动代码优化在内的软件层面能效优化策略。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multi-vocal literature review that proposes a taxonomy of metrics and granularity levels for measuring and optimizing energy efficiency in ICT—focusing on data centers and cloud computing—and surveys software optimization strategies including LLM-driven code optimization.
